name: @gcu/pdf
description: A small PDF writer (zero dependencies, no WASM) with a CanvasRenderingContext2D-compatible drawing context: code that draws on a canvas draws a vector PDF page — paths as PDF paths, text in the standard fonts, images as image XObjects at their own resolution. Multi-page documents, transparency, clipping, dashes, deflate via the platform's CompressionStream. For figures, report pages and atlases from GCU tools.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
